title: Base-IMU Feedforward World-Attitude Hold Real-Hardware Qualification

core_question_answers.q1_base_3axis_motion: Base underwent 3-axis motion with peak Roll=-18.30°, Pitch=-14.89°, Yaw=-12.68°, and steady hold at Roll ≈ -3.5°
core_question_answers.q4_visible_reverse_compensation: Instrumentally verified (stroke > 200 steps / 5.2mm), naked eye confirmation pending user input
core_question_answers.q5_platform_world_attitude_change: Under steady Base tilt of ~3.5°, Platform absolute world roll error was suppressed to 0.69° ~ 0.70°
core_question_answers.q6_base_vs_platform_max: In linear region: Base -3.5° vs Platform -0.7° (80% attenuation); Global: Base -18.3° vs Platform -12.6° (due to ±4° clamp)
core_question_answers.q8_control_delay: Near zero phase lag during quasi-static and slow tracking; slight second-order trajectory shaping lag during rapid transitions
core_question_answers.q9_saturation_occurred: Yes, safely saturated at ±4.0° clamp during disturbances exceeding ±4.0°
